_note:
⛔ SNG-435 §C1, and the measurement is not close. Erik: 'I have been having a hard time getting a good Radiant Lance skill image.' Its `shape` is "damage", so `battleprompt.powerPhrase` — which prefers `shape` over the description on the stated ground that shape is what makes one craft LOOK different from another — produced "Radiant Lance — damage, attack, precise". There is no picture in that.
⚠️ AEVI PREDICTED IT WOULD NOT BE THE ONLY ONE. IT IS ALL OF THEM: 376 of 376 abilities carry a single-word `shape`, 25 distinct category words, not one visual phrase among them. The rule rested on a premise that has never been true of this content.
⚠️ AND THE VISUAL FIELD WAS ALREADY THERE ON ALL 376: `narrationHints`. Radiant Lance's reads "A coherent beam of focused light — silent, precise, instantaneous. Leaves clean scorch lines." A writer with no reader beside a reader with no writer.
_ruling: ⛔ THE DATA SELECTS, THE CODE DEFINES (Aevi's rule, and the `_MAKER_SIGNATURES` precedent). The category words are REGISTERED here, not blocklisted in engine source. A `shape` that is NOT in this list is taken as genuinely visual and still leads the prompt — which is what makes an authored `visualShape` work the day someone writes one, with no code change.
_owner: Aevi. This is a vocabulary of the world's own taxonomy; it is derived from the shipped catalogue but it is content, and adding or removing a word here changes which abilities draw from `narrationHints`.
_measuredAt: 2026-08-15, against 376 shipped abilities: bolster 58 · setup 50 · construct 47 · reposition 41 · guard 34 · damage 33 · healing 26 · hobble 22 · strike 19 · reveal 15 · make 6 · bind/sustain/ward/conceal 3 each · foresee/hinder/travel 2 each · move/heal/empower/shield/break/open/mend 1 each. Every one of the 376 also carries `narrationHints`, so nothing is left without a picture to fall back to.
